```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Everything the page needs is behind one module, because Observable cells
// can only load plain JavaScript through dynamic import(). Resolving the
// specifier against document.baseURI keeps it working under any deployment
// path, including a GitHub Pages project subfolder.
app = import(new URL("assets/js/app.js", document.baseURI).href)

catalog = app.loadCatalog()
variables = catalog.variables
statuses = catalog.statuses

// The selected profile row names its dataset; the plots need the catalog
// entry to know which observations file to register.
datasets_by_id = new Map(
  catalog.regions.flatMap((region) =>
    region.products.flatMap((product) =>
      product.datasets.map((entry) => [entry.id, entry])
    )
  )
)
```

```{ojs}
//| title: Regions and products
viewof selection = app.treeView(catalog)
```

```{ojs}
//| title: Colour key
app.statusLegend(statuses)
```

```{ojs}
viewof row_limit = Inputs.select([100, 500, 2000], {

})
```

## Column {width="46%"}

### Row

```{ojs}
//| title: Profiles

// One row per published profile of the selected product, worst disagreement
// first. Only profiles where at least one source flagged something were
// published, so every row here is worth a look.
viewof profile_row = {
  const rows = await app.profileSummary(selection.datasets, row_limit);
  const columns = [
    { key: "profile_id", label: "Profile", align: "left", format: (v) => v },
    { key: "profile_timestamp", label: "Time", align: "left", format: app.formatTime },
    { key: "n_obs", label: "Obs", title: "Observations in the profile" },
    { key: "n_disagree", label: "Disagree", title: "Observations the two sources disagree on" }
  ];
  for (const variable of variables) {
    columns.push({
      key: `${variable.name}_n_agree_bad`,
      label: `${variable.name} both`,
      title: `${variable.label}: flagged by both sources`
    });
    columns.push({
      key: `${variable.name}_n_original_only`,
      label: `${variable.name} input`,
      title: `${variable.label}: flagged by the input data only`
    });
    columns.push({
      key: `${variable.name}_n_aiqclib_only`,
      label: `${variable.name} aiqclib`,
      title: `${variable.label}: flagged by aiqclib only`
    });
  }
  return app.tableView(rows, {
    columns,
    rowKey: "profile_id",
    sortKey: "n_disagree",
    autoSelect: true,
    empty: "No profiles were published for this product."
  });
}
```

### Row {height="34%"}

```{ojs}
//| title: Product totals
{
  const totals = await app.productTotals(selection.datasets, variables, statuses);
  const byVariable = variables.map((variable) => {
    const row = { variable: variable.label };
    for (const status of statuses) {
      const match = totals.find(
        (t) => t.variable === variable.name && t.status === status.key
      );
      row[status.key] = match ? Number(match.n) : 0;
    }
    return row;
  });
  return app.tableView(byVariable, {
    columns: [
      { key: "variable", label: "Variable", align: "left", format: (v) => v },
      ...statuses.map((status) => ({ key: status.key, label: status.label }))
    ],
    rowKey: "variable"
  });
}
```

## Column {width="54%"}

### Row {height="26%"}

```{ojs}
//| title: Contingency

// The cross-tabulation the whole project is about: how the input's flag value
// and the value aiqclib computed line up, for this profile alone.
{
  const box = document.createElement("div");
  if (!profile_row) {
    box.className = "nq-empty";
    box.textContent = "Select a profile in the table on the left.";
    return box;
  }
  const entry = datasets_by_id.get(profile_row.dataset_id);
  box.appendChild(
    htl.html`<p class="nq-meta"><strong>${profile_row.profile_id}</strong>
      ${entry.label} &middot; ${profile_row.n_obs} observations</p>`
  );
  for (const variable of variables) {
    const rows = await app.profileContingency(entry, profile_row.profile_id, variable);
    box.appendChild(htl.html`<p class="nq-meta">${variable.label}</p>`);
    box.appendChild(
      app.contingencyTable(rows, {
        rowLabel: variable.flag,
        columnLabel: variable.nrt_flag,
        badValues: variable.bad_flag_values
      })
    );
  }
  return box;
}
```

### Row

```{ojs}
//| title: Profile

// Measurement on the x axis, pressure down the y axis, one marker per
// observation coloured by which source flagged it. Scroll or drag to zoom;
// double click to reset.
{
  const box = document.createElement("div");
  if (!profile_row) {
    box.className = "nq-empty";
    box.textContent = "Select a profile in the table on the left.";
    return box;
  }
  const entry = datasets_by_id.get(profile_row.dataset_id);
  const observations = await app.profileObservations(entry, profile_row.profile_id);
  for (const variable of variables) {
    box.appendChild(await app.profilePlot(observations, { variable, statuses }));
  }
  return box;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| title: QC items that fired
{
  if (!profile_row) {
    return htl.html`<p class="nq-empty">Select a profile in the table on the left.</p>`;
  }
  const entry = datasets_by_id.get(profile_row.dataset_id);
  const rows = await app.profileItemBreakdown(entry, profile_row.profile_id);
  return app.tableView(rows, {
    columns: [
      { key: "item", label: "QC item", align: "left", format: (v) => v },
      { key: "flag", label: "Flag" },
      { key: "n", label: "Observations" }
    ],
    rowKey: "item",
    sortKey: "n",
    empty: "No aiqclib QC item flagged anything in this profile."
  });
}
```
